description: `receive ... after 0` always returns :miss in fz. The scheduler is cooperative (src/exec/runtime.rs:1-56, 281), so the spawned child never runs before the check. Elixir promises nothing for after 0 (special_forms.ex:2384-2390). With after 50, all three paths gave :ok on every one of 15 runs. Keep the claim as assert(... == :ok).
